summary: Kanzhun Limited filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong listing rules, detailing ongoing share repurchases for cancellation. The filing discloses multiple daily open-market buybacks from March 20 to April 15, 2026, at prices ranging from approximately USD 6.57 to 7.14 per share, with individual tranches representing 0.036%–0.078% of existing issued shares. Shares repurchased are held for cancellation but not yet cancelled as of the closing balance date. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The program reduces outstanding share count over time, boosting per-share metrics. What to watch: pace of buybacks and cumulative cancellation impact on float.
